column1: # Persian words spelled unlike they sound. A TTS model guesses vowels from letters, so it may read these literally.
# Format: word<TAB>kind<TAB>intended reading. tag_lint.py and ab.py warn when a script contains one and your --lexicon
# has no ✓ row for it. A word here is not always misread: it means "listen before the full run".
# Once a human confirms a spelling by ear, add it to your lexicon with a note that starts with ✓
# (spoken = written when the plain spelling is already fine).
#   ال   the Arabic article: its «ا» is not said as «آ» (بالاخره = bel'akhare)
#   ی=ا  a final «ی» said as «ا» (حتی = hattā)
